        && let Err(error) = finish_terminal_result_owned(manager.clone(), pending.result).await
    {
        fail_child_settlement(&activation, &error);
        return Err(error);
    }
    let (write, state) = {
        let held = manager.read().await;
        let agent = held.exact_activation(identity)?;
        if agent.status == SubAgentStatus::Running
            || agent.completion_claimed
            || !agent
                .activation
                .as_ref()
                .expect("validated activation")
                .execution_settled
                .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire)
        {
            if let Some(state) = agent.activation.as_ref()
                && state
                    .execution_settled
                    .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire)
            {
                let error = "child execution owner ended without acknowledged teardown; result remains uncertain".to_string();
                if state.admission.borrow().is_none() {
                    state.admission.send_replace(Some(Err(error.clone())));
                }
                state.settlement.send_replace(Some(Err(error)));
            }
            return Err(anyhow!(
                "child activation is still running or teardown is uncertain"
            ));
        }
        (
            held.child_state_write(identity),
            agent.activation.clone().expect("validated activation"),
        )
    };
    let outcome = match write {
        Ok(write) => tokio::task::spawn_blocking(write)
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow!("child settlement writer failed: {error}"))
            .and_then(|result| result),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    };
    if let Err(error) = outcome {
        fail_child_settlement(&state, &error);
        return Err(error);
    }
    let mut held = manager.write().await;
    held.exact_activation(identity)?;
    let result = held.get_result(&identity.child_id)?;
    state
        .persisted_terminal
        .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
    if state.admission.borrow().is_none() {
        state.admission.send_replace(Some(Err(
            "child stopped before initial input admission was acknowledged".to_string(),
        )));
    }
    if let Some(agent) = held.agents.get_mut(&identity.child_id) {
        drop(agent.unsettled_foreground.take());
        drop(agent.unsettled_launch.take());
    }
    let activation = held.worker_records[&identity.child_id]
        .spec
        .launch_manifest
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|manifest| manifest.activation.as_ref())
        .expect("validated activation");
    let captured = activation.admission.is_none() || activation.output_captured;
    state.settlement.send_replace(Some(if captured {
        Ok(result.clone())
    } else {
        Err("child execution settled, but exact output capture was not acknowledged".to_string())
    }));
    Ok(result)
}

fn fail_child_settlement(state: &ChildActivationState, error: &anyhow::Error) {
    if state.admission.borrow().is_none() {
        state.admission.send_replace(Some(Err(format!(
            "child stopped before startup acknowledgement; durable receipt is uncertain: {error}"
        ))));
    }
    state.settlement.send_replace(Some(Err(format!(
        "child stopped but its durable receipt is unacknowledged: {error}"
    ))));
}

pub async fn dispose_child_activation(
    manager: &SharedSubAgentManager,
    identity: &ChildActivationIdentity,
) -> Result<SubAgentResult> {
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + CHILD_STOP_SETTLE_GRACE;
    loop {
        let owner = manager.clone();
        let owned_identity = identity.clone();
        let settled = tokio::time::timeout_at(
            deadline,
            codewhale_runtime::runtime_control::owner_work(move || {
                let mut held = owner.blocking_write();
                held.stop_child_activation(&owned_identity)?;
                let exact = held.exact_activation(&owned_identity)?;
                if exact.status == SubAgentStatus::Running
                    && exact.activation.as_ref().is_some_and(|state| {
                        state
                            .execution_settled
                            .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire)
                    })
                {
                    return Err(anyhow!(
                        "child execution teardown is unresolved; ownership remains retained"
                    ));
                }
                Ok(held
                    .exact_activation_descendants(&owned_identity)?
                    .iter()
                    .all(|id| {
                        held.agents.get(id).is_some_and(|agent| {
                            agent.status != SubAgentStatus::Running
                                && !agent.completion_claimed
                                && agent.activation.as_ref().is_none_or(|state| {
                                    state
                                        .execution_settled
                                        .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire)
                                })
                        })
                    }))
            }),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| anyhow!("child disposal could not reach its execution owner"))??;
        if settled {
            return persist_child_settlement(manager, identity).await;
        }
        if tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return Err(anyhow!(
                "child activation disposal has not settled; execution ownership is retained"
            ));
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(SUBAGENT_WAIT_CHECK_INTERVAL).await;
    }
}

async fn run_prepared_subagent_task(
    mut task: SubAgentTask,
    committed: tokio::sync::oneshot::Receiver<PreparedChildLaunch>,
) {
    let owner_admission = task
        .runtime
        .execution_limits
        .as_ref()
        .map(|limits| limits.admission.clone());
    let deadline_ms = task.runtime.worker_profile.wall_deadline_ms;
    let launch = tokio::select! {
        biased;
        () = task.runtime.cancel_token.cancelled() => None,
        () = async {
            if let Some(token) = owner_admission { token.cancelled().await; }
            else { std::future::pending::<()>().await; }
        } => None,
        () = async {
            if let Some(deadline) = deadline_ms {
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(deadline.saturating_sub(epoch_millis_now()))).await;
            } else { std::future::pending::<()>().await; }
        } => None,
        launch = committed => launch.ok(),
    };
    if let Some(launch) = launch {
        task.runtime.worker_profile = launch.profile;
        for denied in &task.runtime.worker_profile.denied_tools {
            if !task.runtime.context.disallowed_tools.contains(denied) {
                task.runtime.context.disallowed_tools.push(denied.clone());
            }
        }
        task.runtime.activation = launch.activation;
        run_subagent_task(task).await;
    } else {
        let (identity, result) = {
            let mut manager = task.manager_handle.write().await;
            let identity = manager
                .agents
                .get(&task.agent_id)
                .and_then(|agent| agent.activation.as_ref())
                .map(|state| state.identity.clone());
            if let Some(agent) = manager.agents.get_mut(&task.agent_id)
                && identity.is_none()
                && let Some(foreground) = task._foreground_child_registration.take()
            {
                agent.unsettled_foreground = Some(foreground);
            }
            (identity, manager.get_result(&task.agent_id))
        };
        if let Ok(mut result) = result {
            result.status = SubAgentStatus::Cancelled;
            result.result = None;
            if let Err(error) =
                finish_terminal_result_owned(task.manager_handle.clone(), result).await
            {
                tracing::error!(target: "subagent", ?error, "prepared child terminal receipt is uncertain");
            }
        }
        if let Some(identity) = identity {
            {
                let mut held = task.manager_handle.write().await;
                if let Some(agent) = held.agents.get_mut(&task.agent_id) {
                    if let Some(foreground) = task._foreground_child_registration.take() {
                        agent.unsettled_foreground = Some(foreground);
                    }
                    if let Some(state) = agent.activation.as_ref() {
                        state
                            .execution_settled
                            .store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
                    }
                }
            }
            let _ = persist_child_settlement(&task.manager_handle, &identity).await;
        }
    }
}

pub const CHILD_STOP_SETTLE_GRACE: Duration = crate::core::engine::FOREGROUND_CHILD_SETTLE_GRACE;

/// Observe the same owned task; timeout keeps its Running/uncertain projection.
/// Never hold the manager lock while Core needs it to project its checkpoint.
pub async fn settle_requested_child(
    manager: &SharedSubAgentManager,
    snapshot: SubAgentResult,
) -> SubAgentResult {
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + CHILD_STOP_SETTLE_GRACE;
    let mut latest = snapshot;
    loop {
        let Ok(manager) = tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, manager.read()).await else {
            return latest;
        };
        latest = manager.get_result(&latest.agent_id).unwrap_or(latest);
        drop(manager);
        if latest.status != SubAgentStatus::Running || tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return latest;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(SUBAGENT_WAIT_CHECK_INTERVAL).await;
    }
}

pub async fn settle_requested_children_for_session(
    manager: &SharedSubAgentManager,
    session: &str,
    parent: Option<&str>,
) {
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + CHILD_STOP_SETTLE_GRACE;
    loop {
        let live = {
            let Ok(manager) = tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, manager.read()).await else {
                return;
            };
            parent.map_or_else(
                || manager.live_count_for_session(session),
                |parent| manager.live_count_for_parent(session, parent),
            )
        };
        if live == 0 || tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(SUBAGENT_WAIT_CHECK_INTERVAL).await;
    }
}

/// Load persisted worker records from an explicit delegated-agent state root.
#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]
pub fn load_persisted_agent_worker_records_with_state_root(
    workspace: &Path,
    state_root: &Path,
) -> Result<Vec<AgentWorkerRecord>> {
    let mut manager =
        SubAgentManager::new_with_state_root(workspace.to_path_buf(), state_root.to_path_buf(), 1);
    let path = default_state_path(state_root)?;
    manager.state_path = Some(if path.exists() {
        path
    } else {
        path.with_file_name(LEGACY_SUBAGENT_STATE_FILE)
    });
    manager.load_state()?;
    Ok(manager.list_worker_records())
}

/// Model-facing session projection returned by the v0.8.33 sub-agent API.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SubAgentSessionProjection {
    pub name: String,
    pub agent_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub run_id: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub resumed_from: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub resumed_as: Option<String>,
    pub status: String,
    pub terminal: bool,
    pub context_mode: String,
    pub fork_context: bool,
    pub prefix_cache: SubAgentPrefixCacheProjection,
    pub transcript_handle: VarHandle,
    #[serde(default = "default_agent_run_follow_up")]
    pub follow_up: AgentRunFollowUpTarget,
    #[serde(default = "default_agent_run_takeover")]
    pub takeover: AgentRunTakeoverTarget,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub artifacts: Vec<AgentRunArtifactRef>,
    #[serde(default = "default_agent_run_usage")]
    pub usage: AgentRunUsage,
    #[serde(default = "default_agent_run_verification")]
    pub verification: AgentRunVerificationSummary,
    pub snapshot: SubAgentResult,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub checkpoint: Option<SubAgentCheckpoint>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub needs_input: Option<SubAgentNeedsInput>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "is_false")]
    pub continuable: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "is_false")]
    pub needs_continuation: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "is_false")]
    pub timed_out: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "is_false")]
    pub timed_out_with_checkpoint: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub worker_record: Option<AgentWorkerRecord>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub fleet_profile: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub child_route: Option<ChildRouteReceipt>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SubAgentPrefixCacheProjection {
    pub mode: String,
    pub parent_prefix: String,
    pub deepseek_prefix_cache_reuse: String,
}

fn subagent_prefix_cache_projection(snapshot: &SubAgentResult) -> SubAgentPrefixCacheProjection {
    if snapshot.fork_context {
        SubAgentPrefixCacheProjection {
            mode: "forked".to_string(),
            parent_prefix: "preserved_byte_identical_when_available".to_string(),
            deepseek_prefix_cache_reuse: "optimized_for_existing_parent_prefill".to_string(),
        }
    } else {
        SubAgentPrefixCacheProjection {
            mode: "fresh".to_string(),
            parent_prefix: "not_inherited".to_string(),
            deepseek_prefix_cache_reuse: "independent_child_prefill".to_string(),
        }
    }
}

fn subagent_checkpoint_is_continuable(snapshot: &SubAgentResult) -> bool {
    matches!(snapshot.status, SubAgentStatus::Interrupted(_))
        && snapshot
            .checkpoint
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|checkpoint| checkpoint.continuable && !checkpoint.messages.is_empty())
}

async fn subagent_session_projection(
    manager: &SharedSubAgentManager,
    snapshot: SubAgentResult,
    timed_out: bool,
    context: &ToolContext,
    worker_record: Option<AgentWorkerRecord>,
) -> SubAgentSessionProjection {
    // Deferred-verification backstop (#6210): terminal commits outside the
    // natural/panic epilogues (Stop, interrupt, session close, stale cleanup)
    // leave verification pending, so the first detail read heals it before
    // the projection reports it. Re-fetch under the session gate afterwards.
    let worker_record = if snapshot.status != SubAgentStatus::Running
        && worker_record
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|record| !record.delivery_evidence.checked)
    {
        ensure_worker_delivery_verified(manager, &snapshot.agent_id, &snapshot).await;
        manager
            .read()
            .await
            .get_worker_record_for_session(&context.state_namespace, &snapshot.agent_id)
            .or(worker_record)
    } else {
        worker_record
    };
    let transcript_session_id = format!("agent:{}", snapshot.agent_id);
    let continuable = subagent_checkpoint_is_continuable(&snapshot);
    let transcript_payload = json!({
        "kind": "subagent_session_snapshot",
        "agent_id": snapshot.agent_id.clone(),
        "name": snapshot.name.clone(),
        "status": subagent_status_name(&snapshot.status),
        "context_mode": snapshot.context_mode.clone(),
        "fork_context": snapshot.fork_context,
        "result": snapshot.result.clone(),
        "steps_taken": snapshot.steps_taken,
        "duration_ms": snapshot.duration_ms,
        "assignment": snapshot.assignment.clone(),
        "checkpoint": snapshot.checkpoint.clone(),
        "needs_input": snapshot.needs_input.clone(),
        "needs_continuation": continuable,
        "timed_out_with_checkpoint": timed_out && continuable,
        "snapshot": snapshot.clone(),
    });
    let transcript_handle = {
        let mut store = context.runtime.handle_store.lock().await;
        let full_transcript_lookup = VarHandle {
            kind: "var_handle".to_string(),
            session_id: transcript_session_id.clone(),
            name: "full_transcript".to_string(),
            type_name: String::new(),
            length: 0,
            repr_preview: String::new(),
            sha256: String::new(),
        };
        if snapshot.status != SubAgentStatus::Running
            && let Some(record) = store.get(&full_transcript_lookup)
        {
            record.handle.clone()
        } else {
            store.insert_json(transcript_session_id, "transcript", transcript_payload)
        }
    };
    let run_id = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .map(|record| agent_worker_run_id(&record.spec))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| snapshot.agent_id.clone());
    let follow_up = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .map(|record| record.follow_up.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| AgentRunFollowUpTarget {
            tool: default_agent_inspect_tool(),
            agent_id: snapshot.agent_id.clone(),
            session_name: Some(snapshot.name.clone()),
            accepted_statuses: vec!["running".to_string(), "interrupted_continuable".to_string()],
            latest_delivery: None,
        });
    let takeover = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .map(|record| record.takeover.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| AgentRunTakeoverTarget {
            kind: default_subagent_takeover_kind(),
            supported: true,
            agent_id: snapshot.agent_id.clone(),
            session_name: Some(snapshot.name.clone()),
            instructions: format!(
                "Inspect agent '{}' through the returned transcript_handle with handle_read; open a replacement with agent if the lane no longer fits.",
                snapshot.agent_id
            ),
            unsupported_reason: None,
        });
    let artifacts = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .map(|record| record.artifacts.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| default_subagent_artifacts(&run_id));
    let usage = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .map(|record| record.usage.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(default_agent_run_usage);
    let verification = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .map(|record| record.verification.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(default_agent_run_verification);
    // Status must stay coherent with the continuation flags below. An
    // Interrupted snapshot that carries a continuable checkpoint
    // (`continuable`/`needs_continuation` true, `terminal` true) means the
    // worker is parked waiting for the parent to act, so it must project as
    // `waiting_for_user` rather than a bare `interrupted`.
    let status = worker_record
        .as_ref()
        .filter(|_| !continuable)
        .map(|record| agent_worker_status_name(record.status))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| agent_worker_status_name(worker_status_from_subagent_result(&snapshot)))
        .to_string();

    SubAgentSessionProjection {
        name: snapshot.name.clone(),
        agent_id: snapshot.agent_id.clone(),
        run_id,
        resumed_from: None,
        resumed_as: None,
        status,
        terminal: snapshot.status != SubAgentStatus::Running,
        context_mode: snapshot.context_mode.clone(),
        fork_context: snapshot.fork_context,
        prefix_cache: subagent_prefix_cache_projection(&snapshot),
        transcript_handle,
        follow_up,
        takeover,
        artifacts,
        usage,
        verification,
        checkpoint: snapshot.checkpoint.clone(),
        needs_input: snapshot.needs_input.clone(),
        continuable: subagent_checkpoint_is_continuable(&snapshot),
        needs_continuation: continuable,
        snapshot,
        timed_out,
        timed_out_with_checkpoint: timed_out && continuable,
        fleet_profile: worker_record
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|record| record.spec.child_route.as_ref())
            .and_then(|receipt| receipt.resolved_profile_id.clone()),
        child_route: worker_record
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|record| record.spec.child_route.clone()),
        worker_record,
    }
}

/// Append-only, per-run backing store for the worker's complete structured
/// message stream. The in-memory `full_transcript` handle deliberately keeps a
/// bounded tail; this artifact is the durable source used by the TUI's Open
/// action when the conversation is larger than that tail.
///
/// Compaction replaces the worker's live history but never rewrites this
/// record: the pre-compaction messages stay, the checkpoint the model now sees
/// is appended after them, and later live messages continue the same index
/// sequence.
struct SubAgentTranscriptArtifactWriter {
    state_root: PathBuf,
    path: PathBuf,
    relative_path: PathBuf,
    /// Message records in the artifact.
    persisted_messages: usize,
    persisted_request_receipts: usize,
    /// Prefix of the current live history already in the artifact.
    synced_live_messages: usize,
}

impl SubAgentTranscriptArtifactWriter {
    async fn for_runtime(runtime: &SubAgentRuntime, agent_id: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let state_root = runtime.manager.read().await.state_root.clone();
        Self::create(&state_root, agent_id)
    }

    fn create(state_root: &Path, agent_id: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let state_root = normalize_subagent_workspace(state_root);
        let relative_path = subagent_transcript_artifact_relative_path(agent_id);
        let path = checked_subagent_transcript_artifact_path(&state_root, agent_id)?;
        let header = json!({
            "kind": "subagent_transcript_header",
            "schema_version": SUBAGENT_TRANSCRIPT_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "agent_id": agent_id,
        });
        create_private_subagent_transcript(&state_root, &path, &json_line(&header)?)?;
        Ok(Self {
            state_root,
            path,
            relative_path,
            persisted_messages: 0,
            persisted_request_receipts: 0,
            synced_live_messages: 0,
        })
    }

    fn unsynced_messages<'a>(&self, messages: &'a [Message]) -> Result<&'a [Message]> {
        messages.get(self.synced_live_messages..).ok_or_else(|| {
            anyhow!(
                "sub-agent transcript history shrank from {} to {} messages",
                self.synced_live_messages,
                messages.len()
            )
        })
    }

    fn sync_messages(&mut self, messages: &[Message], durable: bool) -> Result<()> {
        let unsynced = self.unsynced_messages(messages)?;
        self.append_messages(unsynced, durable)?;
        self.synced_live_messages = messages.len();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn sync_projected_messages(&mut self, messages: &[Message], durable: bool) -> Result<()> {
        let unsynced = crate::image_attach::safe_tool_result_message_projection(
            self.unsynced_messages(messages)?,
        );
        self.append_messages(&unsynced, durable)?;
        self.synced_live_messages = messages.len();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Record a compaction pass: persist whatever of the replaced history is
    /// not yet on disk, append the checkpoint the model sees from now on, and
    /// continue syncing live messages after the replacement history.
    fn record_compaction(&mut self, replaced: &[Message], replacement: &[Message]) -> Result<()> {
        self.sync_messages(replaced, false)?;
        let checkpoints = replacement
            .iter()
            .filter(|message| {
                codewhale_models::turn_classify::is_wire_compaction_checkpoint_message(message)
            })
            .cloned()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        self.append_messages(&checkpoints, false)?;
        self.synced_live_messages = replacement.len();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn append_messages(&mut self, messages: &[Message], durable: bool) -> Result<()> {
        let mut encoded = Vec::new();
        for (offset, message) in messages.iter().enumerate() {
            encoded.extend(json_line(&json!({
                "kind": "message",
                "index": self.persisted_messages + offset,
                "message": message,
            }))?);
        }
        if !encoded.is_empty() || durable {
            append_private_subagent_transcript(&self.state_root, &self.path, &encoded, durable)?;
        }
        self.persisted_messages += messages.len();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn record_request_nudge(
        &mut self,
        turn_id: &str,
        request_index: u32,
        text: &str,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let record = json!({
            "kind": "request_nudge", "turn_id": turn_id, "request_index": request_index,
            "after_message_count": self.persisted_messages,
            "receipt_index": self.persisted_request_receipts, "text": text, "prepared": true,
        });
        append_private_subagent_transcript(
            &self.state_root,
            &self.path,
            &json_line(&record)?,
            true,
        )?;
        self.persisted_request_receipts += 1;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn metadata(&self, complete: bool) -> Value {
        json!({
            "kind": "subagent_transcript_jsonl",
            "schema_version": SUBAGENT_TRANSCRIPT_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "relative_path": self.relative_path,
            "persisted_messages": self.persisted_messages,
            "request_receipts": self.persisted_request_receipts,
            "complete": complete,
            "contains_session_content": true,
        })
    }
}

fn json_line(value: &Value) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut encoded = serde_json::to_vec(value)?;
    encoded.push(b'\n');
    Ok(encoded)
}

fn subagent_transcript_artifact_relative_path(agent_id: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let digest = codewhale_runtime::hashing::sha256_hex(agent_id.as_bytes());
    Path::new(".codewhale")
        .join("state")
        .join(SUBAGENT_TRANSCRIPT_ARTIFACT_DIR)
        .join(format!("{digest}.jsonl"))
}

fn checked_subagent_transcript_artifact_path(state_root: &Path, agent_id: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    checked_subagent_state_path(
        state_root,
        &subagent_transcript_artifact_relative_path(agent_id),
    )
}

/// Read the complete structured worker chat for the TUI Open action. The path
/// is derived from `agent_id` rather than accepted from handle JSON, so a
/// corrupted or model-supplied payload cannot redirect the reader outside the
/// manager state root.
pub fn load_subagent_transcript_artifact(
    state_root: &Path,
    agent_id: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<Message>> {
    load_subagent_transcript_projection(state_root, agent_id, false).map(|view| view.messages)
}

pub struct SubAgentTranscriptDisplay {
    pub messages: Vec<Message>,
    pub conversation_count: usize,
}

pub fn load_subagent_transcript_display_artifact(
    state_root: &Path,
    agent_id: &str,
) -> Result<SubAgentTranscriptDisplay> {
    load_subagent_transcript_projection(state_root, agent_id, true)
}

fn load_subagent_transcript_projection(
    state_root: &Path,
    agent_id: &str,
    display_receipts: bool,
) -> Result<SubAgentTranscriptDisplay> {
    let state_root = normalize_subagent_workspace(state_root);
    let path = checked_subagent_transcript_artifact_path(&state_root, agent_id)?;
    let raw = read_subagent_state_file(&state_root, &path)?;
    let mut lines = raw.lines();
    let header_line = lines
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("sub-agent transcript artifact is empty"))?;
    let header: Value = serde_json::from_str(header_line)?;
    let schema_version = header
        .get("schema_version")
        .and_then(Value::as_u64)
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if header.get("kind").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("subagent_transcript_header")
        || !(1..=u64::from(SUBAGENT_TRANSCRIPT_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VERSION)).contains(&schema_version)
        || header.get("agent_id").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(agent_id)
    {
        return Err(anyhow!(
            "sub-agent transcript artifact header does not match agent {agent_id}"
        ));
    }
    let mut messages = Vec::new();
    let mut conversation_count = 0;
    let mut receipt_count = 0;
    for line in lines.filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty()) {
        let record: Value = serde_json::from_str(line)?;
        match record.get("kind").and_then(Value::as_str) {
            Some("request_nudge") if schema_version >= 2 => {
                let text = record
                    .get("text")
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    .filter(|text| !text.trim().is_empty())
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("sub-agent request receipt has no nudge text"))?;
                if record.get("prepared").and_then(Value::as_bool) != Some(true)
                    || record
                        .get("turn_id")
                        .and_then(Value::as_str)
                        .is_none_or(|id| id.trim().is_empty())
                    || record
                        .get("request_index")
                        .and_then(Value::as_u64)
                        .is_none_or(|index| index == 0 || index > u64::from(u32::MAX))
                    || record.get("after_message_count").and_then(Value::as_u64)
                        != Some(conversation_count as u64)
                    || record.get("receipt_index").and_then(Value::as_u64) != Some(receipt_count)
                {
                    return Err(anyhow!(
                        "sub-agent request receipt has invalid ownership or sequence"
                    ));
                }
                receipt_count += 1;
                if display_receipts {
                    messages.push(Message {
                        role: Role::System,
                        content: vec![ContentBlock::Text {
                            text: format!(
                                "{}{text}",
                                crate::core::events::REQUEST_NUDGE_RECEIPT_PREFIX
                            ),
                            cache_control: None,
                        }],
                    });
                }
            }
            Some("message") => {
                let index = record
                    .get("index")
                    .and_then(Value::as_u64)
                    .and_then(|value| usize::try_from(value).ok())
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("sub-agent transcript message is missing its index"))?;
                if index != conversation_count {
                    return Err(anyhow!(
                        "sub-agent transcript message index {index} does not follow {conversation_count}"
                    ));
                }
                let message =
                    serde_json::from_value::<Message>(record.get("message").cloned().ok_or_else(
                        || anyhow!("sub-agent transcript record is missing its message"),
                    )?)?;
                messages.push(message);
                conversation_count += 1;
            }
            _ => return Err(anyhow!("unknown sub-agent transcript artifact record")),
        }
    }
    Ok(SubAgentTranscriptDisplay {
        messages,
        conversation_count,
    })
}

fn remove_subagent_transcript_artifact(state_root: &Path, agent_id: &str) -> Result<bool> {
    let state_root = normalize_subagent_workspace(state_root);
    let path = checked_subagent_transcript_artifact_path(&state_root, agent_id)?;
    reject_state_path_symlinks(&state_root, &path)?;
    let metadata = match fs::symlink_metadata(&path) {
        Ok(metadata) => metadata,
        Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(false),
        Err(err) => return Err(err.into()),
    };
    if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() || !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
        return Err(anyhow!(
            "sub-agent transcript artifact is not a regular file: {}",
            path.display()
        ));
    }
    fs::remove_file(path)?;
    Ok(true)
}

#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]
pub fn write_subagent_transcript_artifact_for_test(
    state_root: &Path,
    agent_id: &str,
    messages: &[Message],
) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let mut writer = SubAgentTranscriptArtifactWriter::create(state_root, agent_id)?;
    writer.sync_messages(messages, true)?;
    Ok(writer.path)
}

fn default_state_path(state_root: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let state_root = normalize_subagent_workspace(state_root);
    // Canonical delegated state path. Store admission creates its parents and
    // imports legacy state before allowing durable writes.
    checked_subagent_state_path(
        &state_root,
        &Path::new(".codewhale")
            .join("state")
            .join(SUBAGENT_STATE_FILE),
    )
}

fn checked_subagent_state_path(state_root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let state_root = normalize_subagent_workspace(state_root);
    let absolute = if path.is_absolute() {
        path.to_path_buf()
    } else {
        state_root.join(path)
    };
    let file_name = absolute
        .file_name()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("sub-agent state path must include a file name"))?;
    let parent = absolute
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("sub-agent state path must include a parent directory"))?;
    // Resolve through the deepest existing ancestor so Windows short/long names
    // and verbatim (`\\?\`) spellings match the already-canonical state root.
    // A missing parent used to fall back to lexical normalization and could keep
    // an 8.3 component (for example `RUNNER~1`) that no longer prefixes the root.
    let parent = resolve_path_for_containment(parent)?;
    let state_path = parent.join(file_name);
    // The state root may itself sit behind a link the user created: see
    // `effective_state_root`. Both checks below must use the same root, or a
    // relocated state directory fails containment and then fails the walk.
    let state_root = effective_state_root(&state_root, &state_path);
    if !path_is_within_state_root(&state_path, &state_root) {
        return Err(anyhow!(
            "sub-agent state path must stay within state root: {}",
            state_path.display()
        ));
    }
    reject_root_relative_symlinks(&state_root, &state_path)?;
    Ok(state_path)
}

/// The state root in effect for an already-resolved child path.
///
/// `default_state_path` and the transcript artifact writer both build
/// `.codewhale/state/...` under the state root. A user who keeps application
/// state on another volume makes `<state_root>/.codewhale` a junction (or a
/// symlink), which resolves the child outside the state root while landing
/// exactly where that user put the state. When the link exists and the child
/// resolves inside its target, the target is the root the containment check
/// and the link walk must use; otherwise the state root is returned unchanged.
///
/// A child that resolves anywhere else keeps the stricter state root, so this
/// re-roots one known, user-owned link and does not widen the boundary.
fn effective_state_root(state_root: &Path, state_path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let linked = state_root.join(codewhale_config::CODEWHALE_APP_DIR);
    let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(&linked) else {
        return state_root.to_path_buf();
    };
    // Windows junctions are reparse points without the symlink tag, so the
    // shared predicate is required here; `FileType::is_symlink` alone would
    // miss exactly the case this exists for.
    if !codewhale_util::path_identity::metadata_is_link_or_reparse(&metadata) {
        return state_root.to_path_buf();
    }
    match resolve_path_for_containment(&linked) {
        Ok(resolved) if path_is_within_state_root(state_path, &resolved) => resolved,
        _ => state_root.to_path_buf(),
    }
}

/// [`reject_root_relative_symlinks`] for a path that may sit under a state
/// root the user relocated behind a link. Every guard that runs after
/// `checked_subagent_state_path` must reach the same root decision it did, or
/// a relocated root passes that check and fails the write; roots outside this
/// module's state layout come back unchanged from [`effective_state_root`].
fn reject_state_path_symlinks(state_root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    let root = effective_state_root(state_root, path);
    reject_root_relative_symlinks(&root, path)
}

/// Canonicalize `path` when it exists; otherwise canonicalize the deepest
/// existing ancestor and re-append the missing tail. Keeps containment checks
/// on the same identity spelling as [`normalize_subagent_workspace`].
fn resolve_path_for_containment(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    let mut current = path.to_path_buf();
    loop {
        match current.canonicalize() {
            Ok(canonical) => {
                let mut resolved = canonical;
                for component in missing.iter().rev() {
                    resolved.push(component);
                }
                return Ok(resolved);
            }
            Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                let Some(name) = current.file_name() else {
                    return Ok(normalize_path_components(path));
                };
                missing.push(name.to_os_string());
                let Some(parent) = current.parent() else {
                    return Ok(normalize_path_components(path));
                };
                if parent.as_os_str().is_empty() || parent == current.as_path() {
                    return Ok(normalize_path_components(path));
                }
                current = parent.to_path_buf();
            }
            Err(err) => return Err(err.into()),
        }
    }
}

fn path_is_within_state_root(candidate: &Path, root: &Path) -> bool {
    if candidate.starts_with(root) {
        return true;
    }

    // Align both sides onto the same identity spelling before the containment
    // walk. Deepest-existing-ancestor resolve expands Windows 8.3 aliases
    // (`RUNNER~1` → `runneradmin`) and adds a `\\?\` prefix on both the state
    // root and the checked child. Compare after that; still a real containment
    // check (no loose string prefix / no skipped gate).
    let candidate = match resolve_path_for_containment(candidate) {
        Ok(path) => path,
        Err(_) => candidate.to_path_buf(),
    };
    let root = match resolve_path_for_containment(root) {
        Ok(path) => path,
        Err(_) => root.to_path_buf(),
    };
    if candidate.starts_with(&root) {
        return true;
    }

    // Residual alias pairs after resolve are mainly a Windows concern; skip the
    // extra canonicalize walk on Unix so containment stays cheap on hot paths.
    #[cfg(windows)]
    if let Ok(root_canon) = root.canonicalize() {
        let mut cursor = candidate.clone();
        loop {
            if let Ok(canon) = cursor.canonicalize()
                && (canon == root_canon || canon.starts_with(&root_canon))
            {
                return true;
            }
            if !cursor.pop() {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        windows_components_within(
            &strip_windows_verbatim_prefix(&candidate),
            &strip_windows_verbatim_prefix(&root),
        )
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    {
        let _ = (candidate, root);
        false
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn windows_components_within(candidate: &Path, root: &Path) -> bool {
    let mut root_components = root.components();
    let mut candidate_components = candidate.components();
    loop {
        match (root_components.next(), candidate_components.next()) {
            (None, _) => return true,
            (Some(_), None) => return false,
            (Some(r), Some(c)) => {
                use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt as _;
                let fold = |value: &std::ffi::OsStr| {
                    value
                        .encode_wide()
                        .map(|unit| {
                            if (u32::from(b'A')..=u32::from(b'Z')).contains(&(unit as u32)) {
                                unit + (u32::from(b'a') - u32::from(b'A')) as u16
                            } else {
                                unit
                            }
                        })
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                };
                if fold(r.as_os_str()) != fold(c.as_os_str()) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn strip_windows_verbatim_prefix(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let raw = path.as_os_str().to_string_lossy();
    let stripped = raw
        .strip_prefix(r"\\?\")
        .or_else(|| raw.strip_prefix("//?/"))
        .unwrap_or(raw.as_ref());
    PathBuf::from(stripped)
}

fn normalize_subagent_workspace(workspace: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    // Use the same deepest-existing-ancestor resolve as containment checks so a
    // not-yet-created state root still shares the Windows long-path / `\\?\`
    // spelling of paths resolved under it (for example transcript artifacts).
    match resolve_path_for_containment(workspace) {
        Ok(resolved) => resolved,
        Err(_) => {
            let absolute = if workspace.is_absolute() {
                workspace.to_path_buf()
            } else {
                std::env::current_dir()
                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."))
                    .join(workspace)
            };
            normalize_path_components(&absolute)
        }
    }
}

fn normalize_path_components(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let mut normalized = PathBuf::new();
    for component in path.components() {
        match component {
            Component::Prefix(_) | Component::RootDir => normalized.push(component.as_os_str()),
            Component::CurDir => {}
            Component::ParentDir => {
                normalized.pop();
            }
            Component::Normal(part) => normalized.push(part),
        }
    }
    if normalized.as_os_str().is_empty() {
        PathBuf::from(".")
    } else {
        normalized
    }
}

fn reject_root_relative_symlinks(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    // Walk the caller-supplied spellings with symlink_metadata. Do not
    // canonicalize `path` first — canonicalize follows symlinks and would
    // erase the components this check exists to reject (including a symlink
    // leaf that still resolves inside the state root).
    //
    // Windows `\\?\` / 8.3 identity is aligned by callers
    // (`normalize_subagent_workspace`, `checked_subagent_state_path`, etc.)
    // before they invoke us. If strip_prefix still fails, fall back to
    // resolving the *root* and the path *parent* only, then rejoin the leaf
    // so a symlink leaf stays visible to the walk.
    let (walk_root, relative) = match path.strip_prefix(root) {
        Ok(relative) => (root.to_path_buf(), relative.to_path_buf()),
        Err(_) => {
            let resolved_root = match resolve_path_for_containment(root) {
                Ok(resolved) => resolved,
                Err(_) => root.to_path_buf(),
            };
            let aligned_path = match (path.parent(), path.file_name()) {
                (Some(parent), Some(name)) => {
                    let parent = match resolve_path_for_containment(parent) {
                        Ok(resolved) => resolved,
                        Err(_) => parent.to_path_buf(),
                    };
                    parent.join(name)
                }
                _ => path.to_path_buf(),
            };
            let relative = match aligned_path.strip_prefix(&resolved_root) {
                Ok(relative) => relative.to_path_buf(),
                Err(_) => {
                    #[cfg(windows)]
                    {
                        let path_cmp = strip_windows_verbatim_prefix(&aligned_path);
                        let root_cmp = strip_windows_verbatim_prefix(&resolved_root);
                        path_cmp
                            .strip_prefix(&root_cmp)
                            .map(|relative| relative.to_path_buf())
                            .map_err(|_| {
                                anyhow!(
                                    "sub-agent state path must stay within state root: {}",
                                    path.display()
                                )
                            })?
                    }
                    #[cfg(not(windows))]
                    {
                        return Err(anyhow!(
                            "sub-agent state path must stay within state root: {}",
                            path.display()
                        ));
                    }
                }
            };
            (resolved_root, relative)
        }
    };
    let mut current = walk_root;
    for component in relative.components() {
        current.push(component.as_os_str());
        let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(&current) else {
            continue;
        };
        if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
            return Err(anyhow!(
                "sub-agent state path must not traverse symlinks: {}",
                current.display()
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Maximum bytes read from a sub-agent state or transcript artifact file.
/// Generous for long session histories; anything larger is corrupt.
const MAX_SUBAGENT_STATE_BYTES: u64 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

fn read_subagent_state_file(state_root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<String> {
    let state_root = normalize_subagent_workspace(state_root);
    reject_state_path_symlinks(&state_root, path)?;
    let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
    let file_type = metadata.file_type();
    if file_type.is_symlink() || !file_type.is_file() {
        return Err(anyhow!(
            "sub-agent state path must be a regular file: {}",
            path.display()
        ));
    }

    let file = open_subagent_state_file(path)?;
    let mut raw = String::new();
    file.take(MAX_SUBAGENT_STATE_BYTES + 1)
        .read_to_string(&mut raw)?;
    if raw.len() as u64 > MAX_SUBAGENT_STATE_BYTES {
        return Err(anyhow!(
            "sub-agent state file {} exceeds the 16 MiB limit",
            path.display()
        ));
    }
    Ok(raw)
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn open_subagent_state_file(path: &Path) -> Result<fs::File> {
    use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;

    fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
        .open(path)
        .map_err(Into::into)
}

#[cfg(not(unix))]
fn open_subagent_state_file(path: &Path) -> Result<fs::File> {
    fs::File::open(path).map_err(Into::into)
}

fn prepare_subagent_transcript_parent(state_root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    reject_state_path_symlinks(state_root, path)?;
    let parent = path
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("sub-agent transcript artifact must have a parent directory"))?;
    fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
    // Re-check after creation so a pre-existing component cannot redirect the
    // private transcript outside the state root.
    reject_state_path_symlinks(state_root, path)?;
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        codewhale_config::private_directory::tighten_mode(parent, 0o700)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn create_private_subagent_transcript(state_root: &Path, path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
    prepare_subagent_transcript_parent(state_root, path)?;
    let mut file = open_private_subagent_transcript(path, false)?;
    file.write_all(bytes)?;
    file.sync_all()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn append_private_subagent_transcript(
    state_root: &Path,
    path: &Path,
    bytes: &[u8],
    durable: bool,
) -> Result<()> {
    reject_state_path_symlinks(state_root, path)?;
    let mut file = open_private_subagent_transcript(path, true)?;
    if !bytes.is_empty() {
        file.write_all(bytes)?;
    }
    if durable {
        file.sync_all()?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn open_private_subagent_transcript(path: &Path, append: bool) -> Result<fs::File> {
    use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;

    let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new();
    options
        .write(true)
        .append(append)
        .create(!append)
        .truncate(!append)
        .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
        .mode(0o600);
    let file = options.open(path)?;
    codewhale_config::private_directory::tighten_mode_of(&file, path, 0o600)?;
    Ok(file)
}

#[cfg(not(unix))]
fn open_private_subagent_transcript(path: &Path, append: bool) -> Result<fs::File> {
    fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .append(append)
        .create(!append)
        .truncate(!append)
        .open(path)
        .map_err(Into::into)
}

pub fn epoch_millis_now() -> u64 {
    match SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH) {
        Ok(duration) => u64::try_from(duration.as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX),
        Err(_) => 0,
    }
}

/// Compact preview for follow-up delivery receipts (sibling coord surface).
fn truncate_preview(text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
    let mut chars = text.chars();
    let truncated: String = chars.by_ref().take(max_chars).collect();
    if chars.next().is_some() {
        format!("{truncated}…")
    } else {
        truncated
    }
}

fn instant_from_duration(duration: Duration) -> Instant {
    Instant::now()
        .checked_sub(duration)
        .unwrap_or_else(Instant::now)
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DurableSubAgentStore {
    store_schema: u32,
    revision: u64,
    state: PersistedSubAgentState,
    #[serde(default)]
    record_writers: HashMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    writer_sequences: HashMap<String, u64>,
}

impl DurableSubAgentStore {
    fn from_legacy(state: PersistedSubAgentState) -> Self {
        Self {
            store_schema: if state
                .workers
                .iter()
                .any(|worker| !worker.source_usage_records.is_empty())
            {
                4
            } else {
                3
            },
            revision: 0,
            state,
            record_writers: HashMap::new(),
            writer_sequences: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn validate(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            (3..=4).contains(&self.store_schema),
            "unsupported delegated store format"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            self.store_schema >= 4
                || self
                    .state
                    .workers
                    .iter()
                    .all(|worker| worker.source_usage_records.is_empty()),
            "native source accounting requires delegated format4"
        );
        self.state
            .validate_worker_origins()
            .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        self.state
            .coordination
            .validate_replay()
            .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            self.record_writers.len() <= MAX_AGENT_WORKER_RECORDS * 2
                && self.writer_sequences.len() <= MAX_AGENT_WORKER_RECORDS * 2,
            "delegated writer provenance exceeds its capacity"
        );
        for writer in self
            .record_writers
            .values()
            .chain(self.writer_sequences.keys())
        {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                valid_store_writer(writer),
                "invalid delegated writer identity"
            );
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

struct SubAgentStoreTransaction {
    _file: fs::File,
    thread: std::thread::ThreadId,
    image: DurableSubAgentStore,
    publishes: u64,
}

struct SubAgentStoreAuthority {
    state_root: PathBuf,
    path: PathBuf,
    writer: String,
    _lease: fs::File,
    owned: parking_lot::Mutex<HashSet<String>>,
    transaction: parking_lot::Mutex<Option<SubAgentStoreTransaction>>,
    revision: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64,
    published_sequence: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64,
}

struct SubAgentStoreTransactionLease {
    authority: Arc<SubAgentStoreAuthority>,
}

impl Drop for SubAgentStoreTransactionLease {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.authority.transaction.lock().take();
    }
}

fn valid_store_writer(writer: &str) -> bool {
    writer.starts_with("boot_")
        && writer.len() <= 64
        && writer
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'_' || byte == b'-')
}

fn open_store_private_file(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<fs::File> {
    let path = checked_subagent_state_path(root, path)?;
    let parent = path
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store lock has no parent"))?;
    let name = path
        .file_name()
        .and_then(std::ffi::OsStr::to_str)
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store lock has no UTF-8 name"))?;
    let directory = codewhale_config::private_directory::PrivateDirectory::open(parent)?;
    let file = directory.open_internal_file(name)?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        directory.is_at_selected_path()?,
        "delegated store directory changed"
    );
    Ok(file)
}

fn acquire_store_transaction(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<fs::File> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        cfg!(any(unix, windows)),
        "delegated cross-process transactions are unsupported on this platform"
    );
    let file = open_store_private_file(root, &path.with_extension("transaction.lock"))?;
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    loop {
        match codewhale_util::lock::try_lock_file_exclusive(&file) {
            Ok(true) => return Ok(file),
            Ok(false) if Instant::now() < deadline => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)),
            Ok(false) => {
                return Err(anyhow!(
                    "{COORDINATION_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MARKER}; retry delegated operation"
                ));
            }
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        }
    }
}

fn decode_subagent_store(raw: &str, allow_legacy: bool) -> Result<DurableSubAgentStore> {
    let mut value: Value = serde_json::from_str(raw)?;
    let state = if value.get("state").is_some() {
        value.get_mut("state").expect("state checked")
    } else {
        &mut value
    };
    if let Some(workers) = state.get_mut("workers").and_then(Value::as_array_mut) {
        for worker in workers {
            if !worker.get("prepared_generation").is_none_or(Value::is_null)
                && let Some(object) = worker.as_object_mut()
            {
                object
                    .entry("prepared_previous_attempt_unsettled")
                    .or_insert(Value::Bool(true));
            }
        }
    }
    let object = value
        .as_object()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store must be an object"))?;
    let envelope = [
        "store_schema",
        "revision",
        "state",
        "record_writers",
        "writer_sequences",
    ]
    .iter()
    .any(|key| object.contains_key(*key));
    let mut store = if envelope {
        serde_json::from_value::<DurableSubAgentStore>(value)?
    } else {
        anyhow::ensure!(allow_legacy, "delegated store has no format3 discriminator");
        DurableSubAgentStore::from_legacy(serde_json::from_value::<PersistedSubAgentState>(value)?)
    };
    store.validate()?;
    Ok(store)
}

fn read_durable_subagent_store(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<DurableSubAgentStore> {
    decode_subagent_store(&read_subagent_state_file(root, path)?, false)
}

fn sync_subagent_store_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    #[cfg(unix)]
    fs::File::open(path)?.sync_all()?;
    let _ = path;
    Ok(())
}

fn ensure_subagent_store_cutover(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    if path.file_name() != Some(std::ffi::OsStr::new(SUBAGENT_STATE_FILE)) {
        if !path.exists() {
            write_json_atomic(
                root,
                path,
                &DurableSubAgentStore::from_legacy(PersistedSubAgentState::default()),
            )?;
        } else {
            let raw = read_subagent_state_file(root, path)?;
            let store = decode_subagent_store(&raw, true)?;
            if serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw)?
                .get("store_schema")
                .is_none()
            {
                write_json_atomic(root, path, &store)?;
            }
        }
        return Ok(());
    }
    let parent = path
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store has no parent"))?;
    let legacy = parent.join(LEGACY_SUBAGENT_STATE_FILE);
    reject_root_relative_symlinks(root, &legacy)?;
    if path.exists() {
        read_durable_subagent_store(root, path)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            legacy.is_dir(),
            "delegated v3 store lost its legacy-write tombstone; inspect retained data before continuing"
        );
        let _ = codewhale_config::private_directory::PrivateDirectory::inspect(&legacy)?;
        return Ok(());
    }
    let _migration = if legacy.is_dir() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(CoordinationProcessLock::acquire(root, true)?)
    };
    if path.exists() {
        read_durable_subagent_store(root, path)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            legacy.is_dir(),
            "delegated migration did not retain its legacy-write tombstone"
        );
        return Ok(());
    }
    let staging = parent.join("subagents.v1.cutover");
    let backup_name = "legacy.json";
    let original_name = "original.json";
    if !legacy.is_dir() {
        let staged = codewhale_config::private_directory::PrivateDirectory::open(&staging)?;
        let original = staging.join(original_name);
        let backup = staging.join(backup_name);
        let source = if legacy.is_file() {
            Some(legacy.clone())
        } else if original.is_file() {
            Some(original.clone())
        } else if backup.is_file() {
            Some(backup.clone())
        } else {
            let old = checked_subagent_state_path(
                root,
                &Path::new(".deepseek")
                    .join("state")
                    .join(LEGACY_SUBAGENT_STATE_FILE),
            )?;
            old.is_file().then_some(old)
        };
        let raw = source
            .as_ref()
            .map(|source| read_subagent_state_file(root, source))
            .transpose()?
            .unwrap_or(serde_json::to_string(&PersistedSubAgentState::default())?);
        let state = decode_subagent_store(&raw, true)?.state;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw)?
                .get("store_schema")
                .is_none(),
            "legacy migration input is already a versioned envelope; retain it for inspection"
        );
        state
            .validate_worker_origins()
            .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        let mut ledger = state.coordination.clone();
        ledger.validate_replay().map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        codewhale_util::utils::write_atomic(&backup, raw.as_bytes())?;
        if legacy.is_file() {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                !original.exists(),
                "delegated migration retains a previous legacy file; inspect both before retrying"
            );
            fs::rename(&legacy, &original)?;
            sync_subagent_store_directory(parent)?;
            sync_subagent_store_directory(&staging)?;
        }
        anyhow::ensure!(
            staged.is_at_selected_path()?,
            "delegated migration directory changed"
        );
        drop(staged);
        fs::rename(&staging, &legacy)?;
        sync_subagent_store_directory(parent)?;
    }
    let tombstone = codewhale_config::private_directory::PrivateDirectory::inspect(&legacy)?;
    let raw = read_subagent_state_file(root, &legacy.join(backup_name))?;
    let state = decode_subagent_store(&raw, true)?.state;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&raw)?
            .get("store_schema")
            .is_none(),
        "legacy tombstone backup is a versioned envelope; retain it for inspection"
    );
    state
        .validate_worker_origins()
        .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        tombstone.is_at_selected_path()?,
        "delegated migration tombstone changed"
    );
    write_json_atomic(root, path, &DurableSubAgentStore::from_legacy(state))
}

fn store_writer_is_live(path: &Path, writer: &str) -> bool {
    if !valid_store_writer(writer) {
        return true;
    }
    let path = path.with_file_name(format!("subagents.v3.writer.{writer}.lock"));
    let Some(directory) = path.parent() else {
        return true;
    };
    let Ok(parent) = codewhale_config::private_directory::PrivateDirectory::inspect(directory)
    else {
        return true;
    };
    let Some(name) = path.file_name().and_then(std::ffi::OsStr::to_str) else {
        return true;
    };
    let file = match parent.open_owned_file_for_read(name) {
        Ok(Some(file)) => file,
        Ok(None) | Err(_) => return true,
    };
    !matches!(
        codewhale_util::lock::try_lock_file_exclusive(&file),
        Ok(true)
    )
}

fn live_foreign_store_owners(
    image: &DurableSubAgentStore,
    path: &Path,
    writer: &str,
) -> HashSet<String> {
    image
        .record_writers
        .iter()
        .filter(|(id, owner)| {
            owner.as_str() != writer
                && store_writer_is_live(path, owner)
                && image
                    .state
                    .workers
                    .iter()
                    .find(|record| &record.spec.worker_id == *id)
                    .map_or_else(
                        || {
                            image.state.agents.iter().any(|agent| {
                                &agent.id == *id && agent.status == SubAgentStatus::Running
                            })
                        },
                        |record| {
                            !record.status.is_terminal()
                                && !record.parked_at_turn_end
                                && !(record.status == AgentWorkerStatus::WaitingForUser
                                    && !image
                                        .state
                                        .agents
                                        .iter()
                                        .any(|agent| agent.id == record.spec.worker_id))
                        },
                    )
        })
        .map(|(id, _)| id.clone())
        .collect()
}

impl SubAgentStoreAuthority {
    fn open(root: &Path, path: &Path, writer: &str) -> Result<Arc<Self>> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            valid_store_writer(writer),
            "invalid delegated writer identity"
        );
        let _opening = acquire_store_transaction(root, path)?;
        ensure_subagent_store_cutover(root, path)?;
        let image = read_durable_subagent_store(root, path)?;
        sync_subagent_store_directory(
            path.parent()
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store has no parent"))?,
        )?;
        let lease_path = path.with_file_name(format!("subagents.v3.writer.{writer}.lock"));
        let lease = open_store_private_file(root, &lease_path)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            codewhale_util::lock::try_lock_file_exclusive(&lease)?,
            "delegated writer identity is already live"
        );
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            state_root: root.to_path_buf(),
            path: path.to_path_buf(),
            writer: writer.into(),
            _lease: lease,
            owned: parking_lot::Mutex::new(HashSet::new()),
            transaction: parking_lot::Mutex::new(None),
            revision: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(image.revision),
            published_sequence: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(
                image.writer_sequences.get(writer).copied().unwrap_or(0),
            ),
        }))
    }

    fn writer_is_live(&self, writer: &str) -> bool {
        writer == self.writer || store_writer_is_live(&self.path, writer)
    }

    fn is_current_transaction(&self) -> bool {
        self.transaction
            .lock()
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|tx| tx.thread == std::thread::current().id())
    }

    fn begin(self: &Arc<Self>) -> Result<SubAgentStoreTransactionLease> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            self.transaction.lock().is_none(),
            "delegated store transaction already belongs to another thread"
        );
        let file = acquire_store_transaction(&self.state_root, &self.path)?;
        let image = read_durable_subagent_store(&self.state_root, &self.path)?;
        let observed = self.revision.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire);
        anyhow::ensure!(
            image.revision >= observed,
            "delegated store revision regressed; inspect retained state"
        );
        if image.revision > observed {
            sync_subagent_store_directory(
                self.path
                    .parent()
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store has no parent"))?,
            )?;
            self.revision
                .store(image.revision, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
            self.published_sequence.fetch_max(
                image
                    .writer_sequences
                    .get(&self.writer)
                    .copied()
                    .unwrap_or(0),
                std::sync::atomic::Ordering::AcqRel,
            );
        }
        *self.transaction.lock() = Some(SubAgentStoreTransaction {
            _file: file,
            thread: std::thread::current().id(),
            image,
            publishes: 0,
        });
        Ok(SubAgentStoreTransactionLease {
            authority: self.clone(),
        })
    }

    fn current_image(&self) -> Result<DurableSubAgentStore> {
        if let Some(tx) = self.transaction.lock().as_ref()
            && tx.thread == std::thread::current().id()
        {
            return Ok(tx.image.clone());
        }
        read_durable_subagent_store(&self.state_root, &self.path)
    }

    fn publish(
        &self,
        value: &PersistedSubAgentState,
        terminal: Option<&str>,
        generation_prepare: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let mut current = self.transaction.lock();
        if let Some(tx) = current.as_mut()
            && tx.thread == std::thread::current().id()
        {
            self.merge_publish(&mut tx.image, value, terminal, true, generation_prepare)?;
            tx.publishes = tx.publishes.saturating_add(1);
            return Ok(());
        }
        drop(current);
        anyhow::ensure!(
            generation_prepare.is_none(),
            "generation preparation requires its owned store transaction"
        );
        let _file = acquire_store_transaction(&self.state_root, &self.path)?;
        let mut image = read_durable_subagent_store(&self.state_root, &self.path)?;
        self.merge_publish(&mut image, value, terminal, false, None)
    }

    fn merge_publish(
        &self,
        image: &mut DurableSubAgentStore,
        value: &PersistedSubAgentState,
        terminal: Option<&str>,
        coordination: bool,
        generation_prepare: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        value
            .validate_worker_origins()
            .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        if let Some(id) = terminal {
            let candidate = value
                .workers
                .iter()
                .find(|worker| worker.spec.worker_id == id)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("terminal candidate is missing its worker"))?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                candidate.status.is_terminal(),
                "terminal candidate is not terminal"
            );
            let stable_agent = |agent: Option<&PersistedSubAgent>| -> Result<Option<Value>> {
                agent
                    .map(|agent| {
                        let mut value = serde_json::to_value(agent)?;
                        if let Some(value) = value.as_object_mut() {
                            value.remove("updated_at_ms");
                            value.remove("duration_ms");
                        }
                        Ok(value)
                    })
                    .transpose()
            };
            let stable_worker = |worker: &AgentWorkerRecord| -> Result<Value> {
                let mut value = serde_json::to_value(worker)?;
                if let Some(value) = value.as_object_mut() {
                    for key in [
                        "usage",
                        "usage_source_fingerprints",
                        "source_usage_records",
                        "missing_usage_sources",
                        "missing_usage_overflowed",
                        "legacy_unreported_usage",
                        "has_unreported_usage",
                        "updated_at_ms",
                    ] {
                        value.remove(key);
                    }
                }
                Ok(value)
            };
            if let Some(existing) = image
                .state
                .workers
                .iter()
                .find(|worker| worker.spec.worker_id == id)
                && stable_worker(existing)? == stable_worker(candidate)?
                && stable_agent(image.state.agents.iter().find(|agent| agent.id == id))?
                    == stable_agent(value.agents.iter().find(|agent| agent.id == id))?
            {
                sync_subagent_store_directory(
                    self.path
                        .parent()
                        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("delegated store has no parent"))?,
                )?;
                return Ok(());
            }
        }
        if image
            .writer_sequences
            .get(&self.writer)
            .is_some_and(|sequence| *sequence >= value.snapshot_sequence)
        {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                terminal.is_none(),
                "terminal candidate was superseded before durable commit; retain and inspect its winning result"
            );
            return Ok(());
        }
        let owned = self.owned.lock().clone();
        let mut selected = owned;
        if let Some(id) = terminal {
            selected.insert(id.to_string());
        }
        if let Some(id) = generation_prepare {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                coordination && terminal.is_none(),
                "invalid generation preparation publication"
            );
            selected.insert(id.to_string());
        }
        for agent in &value.agents {
            if agent.session_boot_id == self.writer
                || !image.state.agents.iter().any(|saved| saved.id == agent.id)
                    && !image
                        .state
                        .workers
                        .iter()
                        .any(|saved| saved.spec.worker_id == agent.id)
            {
                selected.insert(agent.id.clone());
            }
        }
        let mut next = image.clone();
        for id in selected {
            let preparing = generation_prepare == Some(id.as_str());
            let retained_writer = next
                .record_writers
                .get(&id)
                .cloned()
                .filter(|writer| preparing && self.writer_is_live(writer));
            if let Some(writer) = next.record_writers.get(&id)
                && writer != &self.writer
                && self.writer_is_live(writer)
                && !preparing
            {
                return Err(anyhow!(
                    "delegated worker {id} belongs to a live foreign writer"
                ));
            }
            let incoming = value
                .workers
                .iter()
                .find(|worker| worker.spec.worker_id == id);
            let existing = next
                .state
                .workers
                .iter()
                .find(|worker| worker.spec.worker_id == id);
            let generation = |worker: &AgentWorkerRecord| {
                worker
                    .spec
                    .launch_manifest
                    .as_ref()
                    .map_or(0, |manifest| manifest.generation)
            };
            if preparing {
                let existing = existing
                    .cloned()
                    .map(normalize_worker_record)
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("prepared worker {id} has no durable record"))?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    !existing.prepared_previous_attempt_unsettled,
                    "worker {id} still has an unsettled previous launch"
                );
                let incoming = incoming
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("prepared worker {id} is absent from publication"))?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    !next.state.agents.iter().any(|agent| agent.id == id)
                        && !value.agents.iter().any(|agent| agent.id == id),
                    "generation preparation requires a headless worker"
                );
                let mut expected_spec = existing.spec.clone();
                let manifest = expected_spec
                    .launch_manifest
                    .as_mut()
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("prepared worker {id} has no launch manifest"))?;
                manifest.generation = manifest
                    .generation
                    .checked_add(1)
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("worker {id} launch generation is exhausted"))?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    incoming.spec == expected_spec,
                    "generation preparation changed the worker's exact launch authority"
                );
                let event = incoming
                    .events
                    .back()
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("prepared worker {id} has no event receipt"))?;
                let latest_seq = next
                    .state
                    .workers
                    .iter()
                    .flat_map(|record| &record.events)
                    .map(|event| event.seq)
                    .max()
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    event.seq > latest_seq,
                    "generation preparation has a stale event sequence"
                );
                let mut sequence = event
                    .seq
                    .checked_sub(1)
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("invalid generation event sequence"))?;
                let expected =
                    existing.prepared_attempt(expected_spec, &mut sequence, incoming.updated_at_ms);
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    serde_json::to_value(&expected)? == serde_json::to_value(incoming)?,
                    "generation preparation changed unrelated worker receipts"
                );
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    next.state
                        .worker_origins
                        .as_ref()
                        .and_then(|origins| origins.get(&id))
                        == value
                            .worker_origins
                            .as_ref()
                            .and_then(|origins| origins.get(&id)),
                    "generation preparation changed worker provenance"
                );
            }
            if let (Some(existing), Some(incoming)) = (existing, incoming) {
                let resolving_recovery = existing.recovery_interrupted
                    && !incoming.recovery_interrupted
                    && incoming.status.is_terminal();
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    generation(incoming) >= generation(existing),
                    "delegated worker {id} has a newer durable launch generation"
                );
                if existing.status.is_terminal()
                    && incoming.status.is_terminal()
                    && generation(incoming) == generation(existing)
                    && !resolving_recovery
                {
                    anyhow::ensure!(
                        existing.status == incoming.status
                            && existing.result_summary == incoming.result_summary
                            && existing.error == incoming.error
                            && existing.completed_at_ms == incoming.completed_at_ms,
                        "delegated worker {id} already has a different winning terminal outcome"
                    );
                }
                if terminal == Some(id.as_str())
                    && existing.status.is_terminal()
                    && generation(incoming) == generation(existing)
                    && !resolving_recovery
                {
                    return Err(anyhow!(
                        "delegated worker {id} already has its winning durable terminal receipt"
                    ));
                }
            }
            if let (Some(existing), Some(incoming)) = (existing, incoming)
                && existing.status.is_terminal()
                && !incoming.status.is_terminal()
                && generation(incoming) <= generation(existing)
            {
                continue;
            }
            next.state.agents.retain(|agent| agent.id != id);
            next.state
                .workers
                .retain(|worker| worker.spec.worker_id != id);
            if let Some(agent) = value.agents.iter().find(|agent| agent.id == id) {
                next.state.agents.push(agent.clone());
            }
            if let Some(worker) = incoming {
                next.state.workers.push(worker.clone());
                next.record_writers.insert(
                    id.clone(),
                    retained_writer.unwrap_or_else(|| self.writer.clone()),
                );
            } else if value.agents.iter().any(|agent| agent.id == id) {
                next.record_writers.insert(id.clone(), self.writer.clone());
            } else {
                next.record_writers.remove(&id);
            }
            let origins = next.state.worker_origins.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new);
            if let Some(origin) = value
                .worker_origins
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|origins| origins.get(&id))
            {
                origins.insert(id.clone(), origin.clone());
            } else if let Some(worker) = incoming {
                origins.insert(
                    id.clone(),
                    WorkerOrigin::legacy(worker.owner_session_id.clone()),
                );
            } else {
                origins.remove(&id);
            }
            next.state
                .resume_targets
                .retain(|source, target| source != &id && target != &id);
            for (source, target) in &value.resume_targets {
                if source == &id || target == &id {
                    next.state
                        .resume_targets
                        .insert(source.clone(), target.clone());
                }
            }
        }
        if coordination {
            next.state.coordination = value.coordination.clone();
        }
        let origin_schema = next.state.schema_version.max(value.schema_version);
        next.state.schema_version = origin_schema;
